title: Renew MongoDB Atlas contract ATLAS-2025-1189 with audit rights and an exit clause
description: ATLAS-2025-1189 lapsed on 2026-05-31, but atlas-mumbai still supports order-routing with pii and financial data. Negotiate and sign a renewal or replacement order form using the task 1 clauses: rightToAudit for the entity, SEBI and RBI; an exit clause with minimum execution period and assisted data export; data return and deletion; noticePeriodDays kept or improved. If the vendor refuses the audit clause, escalate to the CISO within 5 working days and record the refusal; do not close the task. Once signed, update company-profile/example-co/vendors/mongodb-atlas.json: contract.reference, startDate, endDate (later than 2026-10-14), rightToAudit true, noticePeriodDays. Validate with node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs. No production configuration changes. Due on the linked finding's SLA deadline (2026-10-14T10:46:39Z), which is earlier than the initiative dueAt.
acceptanceCriteria: A countersigned Atlas renewal or replacement contract exists with an effective date on or before 2026-10-14 and an end date after 2026-10-14.
The signed contract contains a right-to-audit clause naming the entity, SEBI and RBI, and an exit clause with a minimum execution period.

company-profile/example-co/vendors/mongodb-atlas.json shows the new contract.reference, contract.endDate later than 2026-10-14 and contract.rightToAudit true, and node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs exits 0 on that file.

verificationMethod.description: The CISO checks the countersigned contract against the updated mongodb-atlas.json. Expected: reference and dates match, the audit and exit clauses are present, and contract.endDate is later than the review date. Fingerprints c42793cb... and ebeb3183... must no longer be raised when refresh-vendor-ctx runs in task 6.

rootCause.description: No renewal was started before the 30-day notice period ended, so the Atlas contract for a critical order-routing service lapsed. The original contract also lacked audit and exit clauses.
